2019:UHC:16173

WPSS No.638/2015 
Hon’ble Rajiv Sharma, J.
 None for the petitioner. 
 Mr. B.S. Parihar, S.C., for the State. 
 Petitioner participated in the selection 
process for the post of Constable as a general 
category candidate. Petitioner has secured 
145.5 marks. The last candidate who applied 
under the Home Guard Quota under the general 
category has secured 154.25 marks. 
 Since the petitioner was not found suitable, 
he could not be offered the appointment. 
Accordingly, there is no merit in this petition 
and the same is hereby dismissed. 
 Pending application, if any, stands disposed 
of. 
 (Rajiv Sharma, J.) 
 05.04.2018
Rdang
